title: VIEWPORT DWG handle-role validation
scope: Generated in-memory VIEWPORT parser controls for modeled DWG handle roles; no producer, graph-closure, or support claim.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files, version 5.4.1

sections.2.13: Handle type codes 3, 4, and 5 mean hard ownership, soft pointer, and hard pointer. Relative codes 6, 8, A, and C represent soft-pointer references.
sections.20.4.38: VIEWPORT handle-field role and version ordering.

behavior: Validate each parsed VIEWPORT handle against its ODA-defined field role, including version-specific frozen-layer roles.
Admit relative handle codes only for soft-pointer fields and resolve them against the containing VIEWPORT handle.
Accept an absent target encoded with an absolute typed null relation code; require field-role agreement when the reference is non-null.
Reject resolved references that exceed the current public 32-bit handle representation.
Keep parsing transactional: any malformed role invalidates input and resets all partially parsed VIEWPORT state.

generated_controls: AC1018 wrong-role frozen-layer, clip-boundary, named-UCS, and base-UCS handles each fail closed.
Each wrong-role case verifies state reset and corrected-input retry on the same parser instance.
A typed-null frozen-layer handle with absolute code 5 is accepted and leaves the target null.
A relative soft-pointer frozen-layer control verifies resolution against the containing VIEWPORT handle.

physical_observation.finding: Four VIEWPORT frames (handles 0x4A9, 0x4AB, 0x490, and 0x492) contain absent targets encoded with absolute code 5 in fields whose non-null role is soft pointer. Requiring code zero for nulls caused four entity parse failures.
physical_observation.current_reader_result: PASS; the rebuilt reader satisfies the existing sample read harness with zero viewport-induced parse failures.

limitations: Generated controls do not establish physical producer conformance or target existence/graph closure.
VIEWPORT group-91 semantics, layer-override activation/rendering, and native consumer behavior remain unresolved.
No DWG or DXF fixture was added.
